name: list_files
description: List all files in the current isolated task workspace.

name: read_file
description: Read a workspace file. Binary files return a short byte prefix and size.

name: write_file
description: Replace a workspace JSON configuration file with JSON text.

name: config
description: Read the effective application runtime configuration after applying deployment overrides.

name: experience
description: Persistent experience store across independent tasks. Search/get, put (create or fully replace an entry) or delete. You may curate useful experience at your discretion. Content budget 3200 characters; no automatic end-of-task write. Empty search lists entries. Changes are immediately searchable.
